items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Jack Tracy had left by -- [INTERVIEWEE] He'd left.

ctx.x: And that record sold better, I was told, than any of that series that they put out. And I heard -- and I'm not sure it's the truth, but I heard that it had sold as many as 27,000. And I thought, man, that's -- I ought to get a date. And I went up there, and whoever I talked to said, that ain't enough for us.
He'd left. He says, you've got to have at least 100,000 for us to be interested. That'll start making us money.
